answer: Make every identity dock at a narrow jetty: the economy admits only a few newcomers per epoch, and each posts a deposit into a vault that unlocks after months of honest work. A sybil farm then queues for berths like any other boat, its capital frozen while rewards trickle in slowly, and a sudden plume of sign-ups traced to one funding source stands out at the gate. A thousand fakes cost far more than they can earn before the queue moves.
